edits.old: Use the complete post to resolve the meanings of the selected words. Determine what the fragments jointly express on their own: what do they specify about the message, and what do they leave open compared with the complete post?
edits.new: Use the complete post to resolve the meanings of the selected words. Using those same meanings, identify alternative messages that fit what the fragments jointly express but differ on information specified by the complete post. These differences identify what the mask leaves unspecified.
